release.note: The revised README (Narrowings, bullet on n + BLOCK_SIZE <= 2^31, and the Conditions row for n_fits) now gives each excluded range its own reason: the int32 wrap for n > 2^31 (out-of-bounds accesses before the buffers; other programs' elements from n > 2^32 on), an int64 n_elements at n = 2^31 where nothing wraps, and Block.Fits (L8) for 2^31 - BLOCK_SIZE < n < 2^31. work/ranges.py checks each of these for every BLOCK_SIZE = 2^e <= 2^20. This settles the finding.
